scope: Best-effort public corporate-action reconstruction; primary economic terms separated from unverified Irish tax treatment.
economic_units: Contemporaneous unadjusted shares; do not apply these ratios to already split-adjusted price units.
cash_settlement: Event date or next US session, an approximation.
fractional_shares: Retained analytically, ignoring broker cash-in-lieu and minimum holding rules.
spinoff_tax: FMV cost-basis allocation with provisional rollover assumption; a US tax-free statement is not Irish tax advice.
mandatory_disposals: Cash takeovers and legal cancellations occur even though voluntary profitable sales are prohibited.
unknown_rights: Explicit zero mark approximation requires exposure disclosure; not asserted worthless unless legal expiry verified.
